input.answer: Average weekly earnings including overtime for all employees in British Columbia (industrial aggregate, seasonally adjusted) grew 5.2% from August 2025 ($1,302.02) to August 2026 ($1,369.91). Arithmetic: 1,369.91 − 1,302.02 = 67.89; 67.89 / 1,302.02 = 0.0521 → 5.2%.
